UserQuota.title: UserQuota
UserQuota.description: Tracks the authenticated user's daily free preset generation quota and lifetime PRO unlock status across reinstalls and devices.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Optional display email of the authenticated user.

displayName.description: Optional display name of the authenticated user.

dailyDate.description: Current quota date key in yyyy-MM-dd format.

dailyCount.description: Number of free presets generated on dailyDate.

proLifetime.description: Whether the user has unlocked Preset20 AI PRO Lifetime.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the quota record was created (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the quota record was last updated (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CloudPreset.title: CloudPreset
CloudPreset.description: A guitar/bass/acoustic MK-20 preset backed up to the user's personal cloud library.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the preset owner.

favorite.description: Whether the preset is marked as a favorite.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the preset was created (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the preset was last updated (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user document storing daily generation quota and PRO lifetime status.

/users/{userId}/presets/{presetId}.description: Per-user subcollection storing cloud-synced MK-20 presets.
